recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, profile-oriented portrait of a man inside a vehicle, characterized by a desaturated color palette, high-contrast lighting, and a prominent header containing bold slab-serif typography against a dark background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's profile gaze directed toward the left frame edge
High-contrast rim lighting defining the subject's silhouette against the car window
Text header anchored to the top horizontal axis
Muted, cool-toned background bokeh contrasting with warm skin tones
coreInvariants: Desaturated color grading with a slight green/blue tint in shadows
Shallow depth of field blurring the urban background through the window
Top-aligned black bar for primary text placement

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, positioned slightly off-center to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's hand near the face and the bright rim light on the ear and neck.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bold white text at the top, moves down to the subject's face, and follows the gaze toward the left edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy negative space in the top black bar and the blurred window area to the right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark grays in the car interior and header bar.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for typography and highlights on the subject's shirt.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted tan/beige of the trench coat and warm skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark interior and bright exterior light.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones, grayscale, and cool urban blues

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and extended sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight in the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Circular enclosure for a single character to create a focal point within the text string

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed on a solid black background bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, blocky slab serif and a wide, modern sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Circular badge element for a single letter

avoid: Serif fonts with high contrast (like Didot)

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and square terminals.
Matches the wide, technical feel of the subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic, desaturated photo of a man in a tan trench coat sitting in the back of a car, looking out the window. High contrast lighting with bright rim light on his profile. The background through the window is a blurred urban street scene. Leave the top 15% of the image as a solid black horizontal bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold white slab-serif text in all caps on the left side of the black bar. Add a circular white badge with a black letter inside it. On the right side of the bar, add two lines of smaller, extended sans-serif text in all caps.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette desaturated and cool-toned?
Is the text contained within a distinct black bar at the top?
Does the subject have a clear rim light highlight?
Is the typography all-caps and bold?

adjustableVariables: Width of the top black bar
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
Any brand logos on the clothing or car
Parental advisory stickers or specific legal markings
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the black background.
Check that the rim light does not blow out facial details.
Verify the slab serif font has the correct blocky weight.
Confirm the composition follows the top-heavy text hierarchy.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Top Header Bar + Slab Serif Typography + Desaturated High Contrast Lighting
